run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if any pair in an array has a given product x
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify pair product detection correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that uses a set to find pairs with a target product in O(n) time
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like zero elements and negative numbers in the array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which determines if any two elements in an array multiply to a target value x
